closure_class.constructor_semantics: The Object[] constructor assigns the input array reference directly to this.state. It does not clone the array.

semantics: Read this.state[this.state.length - 1] and cast that existing object to org.aspectj.lang.d.
Invoke joinPoint.g(this), attaching the exact closure instance to the existing join-point object.
The int overload then writes the supplied value to this.bitflags.
Return the same join-point object that occupied the final state slot; no new join point is allocated by linkClosureAndJoinPoint.

proceed_contract.semantics: Read attached closure field r. Return null if it is null; otherwise call r.run(r.getState()). The run input is the closure's exact state array reference.

exact_algorithm: if i13 == 0 or i14 == 0, sourceBase = 0; otherwise state[0] = args[0]
if z13 and z14 and z12: sourceBase = i14 + 1; state[0] = args[i14]
if z13 and z14 and !z12: sourceBase = i13 + 1; state[i13] = args[i13]
for input index k from sourceBase to args.length-1: state[(k-sourceBase)+destinationBase] = args[k]
